Using named patterns for specific replacements anon(text, pattern_list = list("PERSON" = "John Smith",                                "EMAIL" = "@\\S+",                                "PHONE" = "\\d{3}-\\d{4}")) #> [1] "PERSON"        "jane.doeEMAIL" "Call PHONE"     # Data frame anonymization df <- data.frame(   name = c("Alice", "Bob"),   email = c("alice@test.com", "bob@test.com"),   score = c(95, 87) )  # Anonymize specific columns by name anon(df, df_variable_names = c("name", "email")) #>         name      email score #> 1 [REDACTED] [REDACTED]    95 #> 2 [REDACTED] [REDACTED]    87  #
